title: Swan Lake Hydroelectric Project Boundary Correction Act
official_summary:
Swan Lake Hydroelectric Project Boundary Correction Act

(Sec.2)This bill directs the Department of the Interior, after consulting with the U.S. Forest Service, to modify the boundary of the Swan Lake Hydroelectric Project (FERC No. 2911) in southeast Alaska and to convey any additional land necessary for the project to the State of Alaska.

summary.headline: A 2018 law directs the Interior Department to adjust the boundary of the Swan Lake Hydroelectric Project in southeast Alaska and transfer any needed extra land to the State of Alaska.
summary.what_it_does: The law tells the Department of the Interior to change the boundary of the Swan Lake Hydroelectric Project, which is in southeast Alaska and has FERC No. 2911. Interior must consult with the U.S. Forest Service before making the change. If the project needs additional land, the law directs Interior to convey that land to the State of Alaska.

who_it_affects.how: The state would receive any additional land that the project needs under the law.

who_it_affects.group: Operators of the Swan Lake Hydroelectric Project
who_it_affects.how: The project's boundary would be changed to match what the law describes.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 20, 2018. The official summary does not describe a separate effective date or timeline for the boundary change or land transfer.
